a.xlink:title: Adds a list item for the given URL, storing the raw URL alongside its displayed label.
Returns the display label for a URL, including its current effective rate limit.
Clamps the user's requested allowance for a host against its developer cap.
Developer-set per-host allowance ceilings (requests/second), keyed by host.
User-set per-host request allowances (requests/second). Missing hosts use the developer default.
